<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Natural Magnetism](/Feats.aspx?ID=4330) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Talos" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=507" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 53

</column>

---

Your connection with elemental iron grants you a natural field of weak magnetic attraction. You can cast [_magnetic attraction_](/Spells.aspx?ID=944) and [_magnetic repulsion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=945) once per day each as 2nd-rank primal innate spells.

**Special** If you chose the [gildedsoul](/Feats.aspx?ID=4325) lineage, you can replace one of the above spells with [_enthrall_](/Spells.aspx?ID=104).
name: Natural Magnetism
